objections.claim: The whole-tree no-listener mechanism closes only descriptors 3 and above with `close_range(3, ~0U, 0)` while preserving fd 0/1/2 without validating their types. A caller can place an already-bound UDP socket on stdin, after which confined code can receive packets using ordinary `read(0, ...)`; `read()` on a socket is equivalent to `recv()` with zero flags ([Linux recv(2)](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man2/recvmsg.2.html)). This bypasses every listed seccomp denial because no socket, bind, listen, accept, recvfrom, SCM_RIGHTS, or pidfd syscall is needed after launch, directly contradicting the inherited-socket regression and the claim that no receiving endpoint survives. The launcher must reject or replace unsafe fd 0/1/2 entries with launcher-created safe descriptors before exec, and regressions must place bound UDP and AF_UNIX sockets plus an io_uring fd independently on each standard descriptor and prove none survives.
